notes.title: Niko and the Cubic Curse is Now Available!
notes.content:
Niko and the Cubic Curse is now available on Windows and MacOS!

This has been a long journey for me, but the game is finally here! Thank you all so much for all the love and support! This game means a lot to me, and I hope you enjoy playing as as much as I enjoyed making it!

If you have encounter any bugs or issues, @CubicCurse on Twitter! We will work on getting a patch out as quickly as possible!

- Josh Rieg

notes.title: Niko and the Cubic Curse Launches September 23rd!
notes.content:
Hey Niko fans!

I am happy to finally announce the release date of my little 2D Platformer! I hope everyone is excited to get their hands on the game on September 23rd!

It has been a very long journey to reach this point. Niko and the Cubic Curse began development over a year ago. It has been tough finding time to work on the game, and I had a lot of very long nights working, but the game is finally reaching completion.

The game will feature an original OST written by Lucas Ferreria and Virgil Grignard! I have worked closely with both of them, and I believe the OST came out amazingly!

Lastly, the Steam Artwork has been updated using a new design by the wonderful William Alan (@chepixelart)! I love this new design a lot and I believe it fits the final game way better than the artwork used since last year.

The final trailer for the game is now live too! Go watch that!

Love y'all! Thank you all for the support!

- Josh Rieg
Lead Developer

notes.title: Playtest Niko and the Cubic Curse Today!
notes.content:
Niko and the Cubic Curse is a 2D Action Platformer about a world where everyone was mysteriously transformed into geometric shapes! Help Niko uncover the mystery of the Cubic Curse!

Currently, Niko is planned to launch in 2021, but what if you can’t wait that long to try it? Well do I have good news for you! Announcing for the first time today, you can play Niko and the Cubic Curse - Steam Playtest Edition, an open beta for the game! It includes the first 6 levels of the game, one of which being a boss fight! 

How do you gain access to the Playtest? Simply go to the Niko and the Cubic Curse Steam store page and hit “request access” The playtest will then automatically be added to your Steam Library.

After you finish the Playtest, Please feel free to give me feedback! Either leave the feedback in the community hub or tag @CubicCurse on Twitter!

This Playtest will only be available from 11/21 - 12/5, so make sure to play it while you can!

Watch the announcement video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=drkRuqRCd6k&t=1s&ab_channel=DaNova
